     b. Calculate the maximum number of servings of dish B that can be made using ingredient i: `max_B_servings = Q[i] // B[i]` if `B[i] > 0`.

def solve(N, Q, A, B):
    max_servings = 0
    for i in range(N):
        max_A_servings = Q[i] // A[i] if A[i] > 0 else 0
        max_B_servings = Q[i] // B[i] if B[i] > 0 else 0
        max_servings += max_A_servings + max_B_servings
    return max_servings
